newsitem.title: USA: RehabCare Group to acquire two companies.
newsitem.headline: RehabCare Group to acquire two companies.

text.p: RehabCare Group Inc said Monday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire both Team Rehab Inc and Moore Rehabilitation Services Inc for an undisclosed amount.

RehabCare said Team and Moore provide contract therapy services to long-term care facilities and outpatient clinics. Team and Moore posted combined annual revenues of $5.6 million in the latest fiscal year ended December 31, RehabCare said.
The company expects the deal to close in a few days.
RehabCare develops inpatient and outpatient care programs.
Its shares were unchanged Monday at 19-5/8.
